title: Aspire 13.5: Fresh pixels and better workflows
description: Aspire 13.5 refreshes the dashboard and aspire.dev, expands the Interaction Service, adds cross-scope Azure references and Kubernetes persistent volumes, and brings live terminals into the AppHost.

title: Aspire in VS Code: the 13.4 developer loop
description: Aspire 13.4 brings more of the local development loop into VS Code: AppHost CodeLens actions, live resource state, dashboard shortcuts, typed resource command prompts, TypeScript AppHost support, and multi-language debugging.

title: Distributed multi-agent systems with Aspire and Microsoft Agent Framework
description: Learn how Aspire, Microsoft Agent Framework, and Microsoft Foundry model, run, observe, and publish a distributed multi-agent AlpineAI ski resort demo.

title: Aspire Multi-repo Rollout at Scale with Agentic AI
description: This is part 2 blog of the windows 365 integration journey with Aspire. This blog focus to show how Windows 365 scaled Aspire adoption with reliability patterns and an agentic AI rollout system across 50+ repos.

title: Aspire 13.4 is here
description: Aspire 13.4 is here with TypeScript apphost GA, typed resource commands with results, server-side CLI log and telemetry search, more mature Kubernetes and AKS deployment, and more.

title: How Azure Chaos Studio ships with hermetic Aspire end-to-end tests
description: Learn how the Azure Chaos Studio team uses Aspire.Hosting.Testing to run hermetic, per-PR end-to-end tests across four services — with emulators, stubs, and no shared environments.

title: Your dev loop is full of tribal knowledge
description: Aspire turns a team’s scattered tribal knowledge into an explicit, incrementally-adoptable app model that humans, scripts, and AI agents can all use.

title: Securing Azure apps with Aspire enterprise networking
description: Network security has a funny way of showing up late. You start with a web app, an API, storage, and Key Vault. The app works. The demo works. Everyone is happy. Then the production checklist shows up: Can storage and secrets be taken off the public internet? Can this app run inside our virtual network? […]

title: What’s New in Aspire 13.3
description: Aspire 13.3 is here with the Aspireify skill, command results, browser logs, Kubernetes and AKS deployment, and more.

title: Aspire 13.2: Bun Support and Container Enhancements
description: Aspire 13.2 keeps the JavaScript story moving with Bun for Vite, more predictable containers, and small but meaningful fixes across debugging and builds.

title: Free Your Terminal with Detached Mode in Aspire 13.2
description: Aspire 13.2 brings detached mode to the CLI. Run your AppHost in the background, free your terminal, and let coding agents start, inspect, and manage your app without blocking.

title: New Aspire database integrations
description: Aspire 13.2 brings MongoDB Entity Framework Core and Azure Data Lake Storage integrations, plus quality-of-life improvements to existing database clients.

title: Running Multiple Instances of an Aspire AppHost Without Port Conflicts
description: Aspire 13.2 introduces isolated mode, letting you run multiple instances of the same AppHost in parallel without port conflicts. Learn how the –isolated flag solves development and testing workflows.

title: Agentic development aspirations: build, run, observe — without more Markdown
description: AI agents can write code but struggle to run and test it. Aspire gives your agent a codified app model to build, run, and observe your whole stack.

title: Aspire Docs in Your Terminal (and Your AI’s Brain)
description: Aspire 13.2 ships aspire docs, a CLI for browsing, searching, and reading official aspire.dev docs from your terminal, with the same source of truth available to AI skills and automation.

title: Aspire 13.2: Dashboard Gets Smarter Export and Telemetry
description: Aspire 13.2 brings powerful new dashboard features for exporting and importing telemetry, querying telemetry via API, and improved GenAI telemetry visualization.

title: TypeScript AppHost in Aspire 13.2: same app model, different syntax
description: Aspire 13.2 enables TypeScript developers to define AppHosts directly in TypeScript, with the same streamlined Aspire application model.

title: Announcing Aspire 13.2
description: Aspire 13.2 brings TypeScript AppHost authoring, an agent-native CLI, Foundry integration, and more.

title: Aspire Conf is Coming! Join us Live on March 23
description: Save the date and tune in for our free, livestream event on March 23. Discover Aspire and learn how it can transform the way you build and deploy your distributed apps and agents.

title: Securing Aspire Apps with Microsoft Entra ID
description: Learn to secure Aspire distributed applications with Microsoft Entra ID authentication. Use AI skills with GitHub Copilot for a 5-minute setup, or follow the detailed guide to understand JWT Bearer protection, OIDC sign-in, and automatic token handling.

title: Adding Aspire to a Python RAG Application
description: This blog post documents the transformation of the azure-search-openai-demo (a Python/TypeScript RAG application) through the addition of Aspire for local development and observability. It demonstrates how Aspire can enhance polyglot applications without requiring rewrites.

title: Aspire for JavaScript developers
description: Aspire 13 brings comprehensive JavaScript and TypeScript support to cloud-native development, enabling you to orchestrate Node.js applications, Vite frontends, and JavaScript services alongside your .NET projects with unified tooling and seamless integration.

title: Scaling AI Agents with Aspire: The Missing Isolation Layer for Parallel Development
description: Scaling AI agent development with Aspire and Git worktrees by solving port conflicts through automatic port allocation scripts and an MCP proxy layer that enables parallel AI agents to orchestrate and debug complete distributed systems simultaneously.

title: Aspire 13.1 – Our holiday gift to you
description: Aspire 13.1 is here with CLI-based MCP for AI agents, dashboard improvements, Azure updates, and TLS termination support.

title: Aspire Integrations, Batteries Included
description: Aspire provides a *batteries included* approach through **integrations**

title: Python is First Class in Aspire 13
description: Aspire 13 introduces first-class Python support with dedicated APIs for hosting Python applications, modules, and ASGI web apps alongside your .NET services.

title: Pipe dreams to pipeline realities: an Aspire Pipelines story
description: A deep dive into the evolution of Aspire Pipelines from basic callbacks in version 9.4 to the sophisticated pipeline execution model in Aspire 13, covering deployment orchestration, concurrency, and state management.

title: Celebrating Community Contributions in Aspire 13
description: Celebrates Aspire 13.0 community contributions, highlighting key PRs that improved App Service, Kusto workflows, dashboards, and cross-language support.

title: Migrating from Microsoft Learn to aspire.dev
description: Learn how we migrated all Aspire docs from Learn to the new website aspire.dev learn

title: Aspire Multi-Repo Microservices – Windows 365 Integration Journey
description: How Windows 365 extends Aspire to streamline multi-repo microservice development using microservice resources, emulators, automated seed data, and cloud-based end-to-end validation.

title: Aspire 13 – Aspireify anything
description: Aspire 13 is here with revamped JS and Python experiences, new AI-focused grations, and a new iteration of deployment tooling.

title: 💫 Welcome to the New Aspire: Your Stack, Streamlined
description: Aspire goes polyglot. Explore the new Aspire.dev — a unified, open-source platform for building, observing, and deploying distributed apps in any language.
